hooks.name: Style guard
hooks.description: Checks seed content and templates against the teletext style rules when saved.

action.prompt: A teletext content file (seed pages, templates or system pages) was just saved. Read .kiro/steering/teletext-style.md, then check the page content in the saved file against it. Report violations only: headlines over 38 characters or not uppercase, dates not written like "Mon 12 Nov", times not in 24-hour form, money not written like N2,500, emoji or non-ASCII characters, curly quotes or long dashes, invented-looking real people or phone numbers (demo data must be fake), and pages with no link back to 100. Do not edit files unless asked.
